World Leading Manufacturer of Fountains and Display Aerators

Aqua Control® has a mission:
to provide the world with the greatest fountains and display aerators, along with amazing customer
service and technical support.

Aqua Control® is continually doing research and development in the industry, leading the way for a
continual flow of incredible water features. Aqua Control® has a stunning range of products from
Do-It-Yourself plug and perform fountains, to towering Titans blasting geysers 100 feet tall.

We also have everything in between, from waterfalls, healthy pond and lake aeration products, to
brilliant lighting systems to enjoy your water feature at night, as well as the day. Since 1970,
Aqua Control® has built a healthy appreciation of Earth’s most precious resource, water.

Aqua Control® focuses on creating and maintaining the best patterns in the industry. Aqua Control’s®
patterns yield consistent solid thick streams that stay strong in a breeze and maintain a consistent
flow for a great distance.

Aqua Control® provides pumps that not only produce high volumes, with high pressures, but also
breathtaking patterns, while concentrating on motor longevity, providing a long lasting and
affordable pump.

to provide the world with the greatest fountains and display aerators, along with amazing customer
service and technical support.

Aqua Control® is continually doing research and development in the industry, leading the way for a
continual flow of incredible water features. Aqua Control® has a stunning range of products from
Do-It-Yourself plug and perform fountains, to towering Titans blasting geysers 100 feet tall.

We also have everything in between, from waterfalls, healthy pond and lake aeration products, to
brilliant lighting systems to enjoy your water feature at night, as well as the day. Since 1970,
Aqua Control® has built a healthy appreciation of Earth’s most precious resource, water.

Aqua Control® focuses on creating and maintaining the best patterns in the industry. Aqua Control’s®
patterns yield consistent solid thick streams that stay strong in a breeze and maintain a consistent
flow for a great distance.

Aqua Control® provides pumps that not only produce high volumes, with high pressures, but also
breathtaking patterns, while concentrating on motor longevity, providing a long lasting and
affordable pump.

## Our promise to you

### 30-day money back guarantee

HugeDomains provides a 100% satisfaction guarantee on every domain name that we sell through our
website. If you buy a domain and are unhappy with it, we will accept the return within 30 days and
issue a full refund – no questions asked.

### Quick delivery of the domain

In most cases access to the domain will be available within one to two hours of purchase, however
access to domains purchased after business hours will be available within the next business day.

### Safe and secure shopping

Your online safety and security is our top priority. We understand the importance of protecting your
personal information.

We protect your information through SSL encryption technology, providing the safest, most secure
shopping experience possible. Additionally, you may checkout with PayPal or Escrow.com.

## FAQs

[See more FAQs][23]
[How do I transfer to another registrar such as GoDaddy?][24]

Yes, you can transfer your domain to any registrar or hosting company once you have purchased it.
Since domain transfers are a manual process, it can take up to 5 days to transfer the domain.

 

Domains purchased with payment plans are not eligible to transfer until all payments have been made.
Please remember that our 30-day money back guarantee is void once a domain has been transferred.

 

For transfer instructions to GoDaddy, please [click here][25].

[How do I get the domain after the purchase?][26]

Once you purchase the domain we will push it into an account for you at our registrar,
NameBright.com, we will then send you an email with your NameBright username and password. In most
cases access to the domain will be available within one to two hours of purchase, however access to
domains purchased after business hours will be available within the next business day.

[What comes with the domain name?][27]

Nothing else is included with the purchase of the domain name. Our registrar NameBright.com does
offer email packages for a yearly fee, however you will need to find hosting and web design services
on your own.

[Do you offer payment plans?][28]

Yes we offer payment plans for up to 12 months. [See details][29].

[How do I keep my personal information private?][30]

If you wish the domain ownership information to be private, add WhoIs Privacy Protection to your
domain. This hides your personal information from the general public.

 

To add privacy protection to your domain, do so within your registrar account. NameBright offers
WhoIs Privacy Protection for free for the first year, and then for a small fee for subsequent years.

 

Whois information is not updated immediately. It typically takes several hours for Whois data to
update, and different registrars are faster than others. Usually your Whois information will be
fully updated within two days.

[See more FAQs][31]

## Our promise to you

### 30-day money back guarantee

HugeDomains provides a 100% satisfaction guarantee on every domain name that we sell through our
website. If you buy a domain and are unhappy with it, we will accept the return within 30 days and
issue a full refund – no questions asked.

### Quick delivery of the domain

In most cases access to the domain will be available within one to two hours of purchase, however
access to domains purchased after business hours will be available within the next business day.

### Safe and secure shopping

Your online safety and security is our top priority. We understand the importance of protecting your
personal information.

We protect your information through SSL encryption technology, providing the safest, most secure
shopping experience possible. Additionally, you may checkout with PayPal or Escrow.com.

## FAQs

[See more FAQs][23]
[How do I transfer to another registrar such as GoDaddy?][24]

Yes, you can transfer your domain to any registrar or hosting company once you have purchased it.
Since domain transfers are a manual process, it can take up to 5 days to transfer the domain.

 

Domains purchased with payment plans are not eligible to transfer until all payments have been made.
Please remember that our 30-day money back guarantee is void once a domain has been transferred.

 

For transfer instructions to GoDaddy, please [click here][25].

[How do I get the domain after the purchase?][26]

Once you purchase the domain we will push it into an account for you at our registrar,
NameBright.com, we will then send you an email with your NameBright username and password. In most
cases access to the domain will be available within one to two hours of purchase, however access to
domains purchased after business hours will be available within the next business day.

[What comes with the domain name?][27]

Nothing else is included with the purchase of the domain name. Our registrar NameBright.com does
offer email packages for a yearly fee, however you will need to find hosting and web design services
on your own.

[Do you offer payment plans?][28]

Yes we offer payment plans for up to 12 months. [See details][29].

[How do I keep my personal information private?][30]

If you wish the domain ownership information to be private, add WhoIs Privacy Protection to your
domain. This hides your personal information from the general public.

 

To add privacy protection to your domain, do so within your registrar account. NameBright offers
WhoIs Privacy Protection for free for the first year, and then for a small fee for subsequent years.

 

Whois information is not updated immediately. It typically takes several hours for Whois data to
update, and different registrars are faster than others. Usually your Whois information will be
fully updated within two days.

[See more FAQs][31]

June 22, 2026June 3, 2026
[ [Texas Wildlife Complete Guide][Texas Wildlife Complete Guide] ][62]

Texas wildlife is as varied as the state itself – across deserts, mountains, forests, prairies,
rivers, and coastal marshes, Texas supports an extraordinary mix of animals and habitats.

Some species, such as the armadillo and Texas horned lizard, are closely tied to the state’s
identity, while others, including the whooping crane, Kemp’s ridley sea turtle, and ocelot, make
Texas an important place for conservation.

[Read more][63]

Categories [Wildlife by State][64]

## [Florida Woodpeckers: Photos & Identification Guide to Common Species][65]

May 30, 2026
[ [Florida Woodpeckers][Florida Woodpeckers] ][66]

Florida Woodpeckers play an important role in the Sunshine state’s forest ecosystems by controlling
populations of insects that can damage trees, including beetles, ants, and other wood-boring pests.

The nesting cavities excavated by woodpeckers also provide shelter for many other wildlife species,
such as owls, bluebirds, squirrels, and bats, making woodpeckers valuable contributors to forest
biodiversity.

This guide highlights key woodpecker species commonly found in Florida, including the Downy
Woodpecker, Hairy Woodpecker, Ivory-billed Woodpecker, Northern Flicker, Pileated Woodpecker,
Red-bellied Woodpecker, Red-cockaded Woodpecker, Red-headed Woodpecker, and Yellow-bellied
Sapsucker.

Each species is described with a focus on identification features and natural history to assist
birdwatchers and naturalists in recognizing these birds in the field.

[Read more][67]

Categories [Animal Lists][68], [Birds][69]

# FISH & WILDLIFE ARE
# WHAT WE LIVE FOR.

**MAKING ECOLOGICAL DATA MORE LOGICAL**

[Product Catalog][60]
[Let’s Talk][61]

## SPECIALISTS IN IDENTIFICATION SOLUTIONS

PIT tags. Antennas. Data and analytics. These are some of the innovative technologies we offer. But
what really matters is why we offer them. Conservation, sustainability, and aquaculture are our
passion. We’re committed to improving the environment, preserving fish and wildlife populations, and
helping our world’s food sources for generations to come. That’s why we’re constantly partnering
with researchers to develop new technologies. And it’s all backed by unmatched service and a support
team to help you succeed. Because the world needs healthy ecosystems. And healthy ecosystems need
you.

**For any inquiries outside of North America, please reach out to our Boise office**

208-275-0011

## Custom PIT Tag Monitoring Solutions

[Biomark]

Biomark specializes in the design, construction, and installation of custom PIT tag systems for
terrestrial and aquatic use. Our experience allows us to design and test numerous antenna sizes and
configurations to meet the needs of unique monitoring applications. Whether your site is in a
metropolis or on a remote mountaintop, we can provide a monitoring solution. We have been building
customized PIT tag detection systems for nearly 30 years. No project is too big or small and our
carefully selected components collectively result in a robust and reliable system. Take a look at a
few of our [terrestrial][81], [aquatic][82] and [custom system solutions][83] or contact our
team [biomarkservice@merck.com][84] to discuss your project needs.

## SPECIALISTS IN IDENTIFICATION SOLUTIONS

PIT tags. Antennas. Data and analytics. These are some of the innovative technologies we offer. But
what really matters is why we offer them. Conservation, sustainability, and aquaculture are our
passion. We’re committed to improving the environment, preserving fish and wildlife populations, and
helping our world’s food sources for generations to come. That’s why we’re constantly partnering
with researchers to develop new technologies. And it’s all backed by unmatched service and a support
team to help you succeed. Because the world needs healthy ecosystems. And healthy ecosystems need
you.

**For any inquiries outside of North America, please reach out to our Boise office**

## Custom PIT Tag Monitoring Solutions

[Biomark]

Biomark specializes in the design, construction, and installation of custom PIT tag systems for
terrestrial and aquatic use. Our experience allows us to design and test numerous antenna sizes and
configurations to meet the needs of unique monitoring applications. Whether your site is in a
metropolis or on a remote mountaintop, we can provide a monitoring solution. We have been building
customized PIT tag detection systems for nearly 30 years. No project is too big or small and our
carefully selected components collectively result in a robust and reliable system. Take a look at a
few of our [terrestrial][81], [aquatic][82] and [custom system solutions][83] or contact our
team [biomarkservice@merck.com][84] to discuss your project needs.

experience as a supplier of industrial and marine pumps handling chemicals, food and beverages,
water, fuels and lubricants, that’s where Castle Pumps can help you. We will get you the right pump,
not one that just “does the job” saving you from excessive wear, unnecessary maintenance, product
waste, process failures and energy costs.

[Wine Transfer in Winery - Flexible Impeller Pump]

## Wine Transfer in Winery - Flexible Impeller Pump

We received an enquiry from a contract winemaker based in the UK. They required a food grade pump to
transfer wine at temperatures between 2 and 65⁰C, with a maximum flow rate of 15,000 litres per hour
and ideally the option of variable speed to enable more control. Due to the nature of their
application and the specifications required, we supplied the Liverani All in One Flexible Impeller
Pump which was a perfect fit for their requirements.

][139] [
[Lamella Settlement Tank Emptying - Peristaltic Pump]

## Lamella Settlement Tank Emptying - Peristaltic Pump

We received an enquiry from Northern Tanks, a fabricator of fluid storage tanks and transfer
systems. They were in the process of a designing a steel container which would enclose a water tank
with pressure washers connected, used to wash down site equipment. Once used, the collected water
would be passed through a Lamella Separator and Filter to remove any large solid particles and
returned to the original water tank to use again.

][140] [
[Vape Flavour Dispensing from IBCs - Food Grade Barrel Pump]

## Vape Flavour Dispensing from IBCs - Food Grade Barrel Pump

Castle Pumps received an enquiry from a manufacturer of vape liquids and flavours who were looking
to upscale their production. Part of this involved improving the efficiency of transferring the
concentrated flavours from the IBCs where they are stored. The customer was looking for a number of
container emptying solutions for fitting onto the IBCs and dispensing the favours without manually
handling the fluid. They were looking for a number of container emptying solutions for fitting onto
IBCs.

returned to the original water tank to use again.

## Our Company

For 50 years, Cat Pumps has offered the most dependable positive displacement high-pressure triplex
pumps available. Designed and built to the highest quality standards, customers count on Cat Pumps
products to keep their equipment running. Every design detail of Cat Pumps products is optimized for
long-life and reliable performance, making Cat Pumps the most trusted name in high-pressure pumps
and systems.

[Read More][196]

## Quality Performance for Everyday Applications

Backed by the industry's best delivery, customer service, and technical support, Cat Pumps products
and service parts are readily available when you need them. A worldwide network of highly qualified
distributors provides sales and service support for pumps, parts and accessories when servicing is

###### about us

## Anhui Changyu Pump and Valve Manufacturing Co., Ltd.

**Changyu Pump** is a trusted **chemical pump manufacturer** established in 2006, specializing
in corrosion-resistant pump solutions for aggressive and complex fluids. Our main products
include magnetic drive pumps, centrifugal pumps, self-priming pumps, slurry pumps, and submersible
pumps, widely used in chemical processing, electroplating, wastewater treatment, mining, and
environmental applications.

* 01
  
  2026.03
  
  [Hefei Huasheng Pumps & Valves Named One of Hefei’s Outstanding Contributing Enterprises for
  2025][128]
  Hefei Huasheng Pumps & Valves Co., Ltd. has been recognized as one of Hefei’s Outstanding
  Contributing Enterprises for 2025, following an announcement made at the city’s Science and
  Technology Innovation Conference on February 24.         The recognition highlights the company's
  achievements in high-end pump and valve manufacturing and its contribution to the development of
  advanced industrial equipment. Hefei Huasheng Pumps & Valves has built a strong reputation in the
  petrochemical and energy sectors through continuous investment in technology and product
  development. Over the years, the company has developed a number of key products for demanding
  industrial applications, including ebullated-bed reactor pumps, loop reactor axial-flow pumps, and
  absorption tower circulation pumps. Several of these technologies have helped reduce reliance on
  imported equipment in China's energy and petrochemical industries. Hefei Huasheng Pumps &
  Valves also operates advanced R&D platforms, including a national postdoctoral research
  workstation, and has obtained more than 200 patents. The company has participated in the
  development of multiple industry standards and continues to expand its technological capabilities.
  Looking ahead, Hefei Huasheng Pumps & Valves will continue to focus on innovation and high-quality
  manufacturing while strengthening collaboration with research institutions and industry partners
  to support the future development of advanced equipment manufacturing.  
  [ [Hefei Huasheng Pumps & Valves Named One of Hefei’s Outstanding Contributing Enterprises for
  2025] ][129]
* 22
  
  2026.01
  
  [Hefei Huasheng Pumps & Valves Receives Further Industry Honors, Leading High-Quality Development
  of the Pump Industry Through Standards][130]
  Recently, the Inaugural Meeting of the 7th National Technical Committee on Pump Standardization
  and its 2025 Working Conference was convened in Deqing County, Huzhou City, Zhejiang Province.
  Hefei Huasheng Pumps & Valves Co., Ltd. was invited to attend the meeting in recognition of its
  active role and contributions to pump industry standardization. During the conference, Huasheng
  Pumps & Valves received multiple prestigious honors, reflecting its solid technical expertise and
  long-term commitment to standard development and implementation. The company was recognized as the
  leading drafting organization for both the industry standard JB/T 11008-2025 High-Speed
  Partial-Flow Pumps and the national standard GB/T 3215-2025 Centrifugal Pumps for Petroleum,
  Petrochemical and Natural Gas Industries. In addition, Huasheng was awarded the title of “Advanced
  Unit in National Pump Industry Standardization during the 14th Five-Year Plan Period” and was
  officially appointed as a member organization of the 7th National Technical Committee on Pump
  Standardization, underscoring the industry’s strong recognition of its technical strength and
  sense of responsibility. As a core contributor to pump industry standard formulation, Huasheng
  Pumps & Valves upholds the philosophy of “driving innovation through standards and building
  excellence through quality.” Over the past decade, the company has led or participated in the
  development of more than 40 national, industry, and group standards, covering key product segments
  such as centrifugal pumps, chemical pumps, and special-purpose pumps. These standards span
  critical stages across the entire industrial chain and provide an important foundation for the
  standardized and sustainable development of the pump industry. Looking ahead, Huasheng Pumps &
  Valves will continue to actively participate in the construction and improvement of the pump
  industry standardization system. By integrating advanced technologies with rigorous standards, the
  company remains committed to promoting high-quality industry development and contributing to the
  enhancement of the global influence and competitiveness of China’s pump industry.
  [ [Hefei Huasheng Pumps & Valves Receives Further Industry Honors, Leading High-Quality
  Development of the Pump Industry Through Standards] ][131]

  [Huasheng Pumps & Valves to Exhibit at IIW 2026 in Jakarta, Indonesia][126]
  We are pleased to announce that Hefei Huasheng Pumps & Valves Co., Ltd. will participate as an

  the world to visit our booth, exchange ideas, and explore opportunities for cooperation. Your
  presence will be highly valued, and we look forward to productive discussions during the
  exhibition.   You are welcome to visit us at Booth No. A3D115
  [ [Huasheng Pumps & Valves to Exhibit at IIW 2026 in Jakarta, Indonesia] ][127]
* 01
  
  2026.03
  
  [Hefei Huasheng Pumps & Valves Named One of Hefei’s Outstanding Contributing Enterprises for
  2025][128]
  Hefei Huasheng Pumps & Valves Co., Ltd. has been recognized as one of Hefei’s Outstanding
  Contributing Enterprises for 2025, following an announcement made at the city’s Science and
  Technology Innovation Conference on February 24.         The recognition highlights the company's
  achievements in high-end pump and valve manufacturing and its contribution to the development of
  advanced industrial equipment. Hefei Huasheng Pumps & Valves has built a strong reputation in the
  petrochemical and energy sectors through continuous investment in technology and product
  development. Over the years, the company has developed a number of key products for demanding
  industrial applications, including ebullated-bed reactor pumps, loop reactor axial-flow pumps, and
  absorption tower circulation pumps. Several of these technologies have helped reduce reliance on
  imported equipment in China's energy and petrochemical industries. Hefei Huasheng Pumps &
  Valves also operates advanced R&D platforms, including a national postdoctoral research
  workstation, and has obtained more than 200 patents. The company has participated in the
  development of multiple industry standards and continues to expand its technological capabilities.
  Looking ahead, Hefei Huasheng Pumps & Valves will continue to focus on innovation and high-quality
  manufacturing while strengthening collaboration with research institutions and industry partners
  to support the future development of advanced equipment manufacturing.  
  [ [Hefei Huasheng Pumps & Valves Named One of Hefei’s Outstanding Contributing Enterprises for
  2025] ][129]
* 22
  
  2026.01
  
  [Hefei Huasheng Pumps & Valves Receives Further Industry Honors, Leading High-Quality Development
  of the Pump Industry Through Standards][130]
  Recently, the Inaugural Meeting of the 7th National Technical Committee on Pump Standardization
  and its 2025 Working Conference was convened in Deqing County, Huzhou City, Zhejiang Province.
  Hefei Huasheng Pumps & Valves Co., Ltd. was invited to attend the meeting in recognition of its
  active role and contributions to pump industry standardization. During the conference, Huasheng
  Pumps & Valves received multiple prestigious honors, reflecting its solid technical expertise and
  long-term commitment to standard development and implementation. The company was recognized as the
  leading drafting organization for both the industry standard JB/T 11008-2025 High-Speed
  Partial-Flow Pumps and the national standard GB/T 3215-2025 Centrifugal Pumps for Petroleum,
  Petrochemical and Natural Gas Industries. In addition, Huasheng was awarded the title of “Advanced
  Unit in National Pump Industry Standardization during the 14th Five-Year Plan Period” and was
  officially appointed as a member organization of the 7th National Technical Committee on Pump
  Standardization, underscoring the industry’s strong recognition of its technical strength and
  sense of responsibility. As a core contributor to pump industry standard formulation, Huasheng
  Pumps & Valves upholds the philosophy of “driving innovation through standards and building
  excellence through quality.” Over the past decade, the company has led or participated in the
  development of more than 40 national, industry, and group standards, covering key product segments
  such as centrifugal pumps, chemical pumps, and special-purpose pumps. These standards span
  critical stages across the entire industrial chain and provide an important foundation for the
  standardized and sustainable development of the pump industry. Looking ahead, Huasheng Pumps &
  Valves will continue to actively participate in the construction and improvement of the pump
  industry standardization system. By integrating advanced technologies with rigorous standards, the
  company remains committed to promoting high-quality industry development and contributing to the
  enhancement of the global influence and competitiveness of China’s pump industry.
  [ [Hefei Huasheng Pumps & Valves Receives Further Industry Honors, Leading High-Quality
  Development of the Pump Industry Through Standards] ][131]

intelligent auxiliary control monitoring system, intelligent non-negative pressure full frequency

**About Us**

We, C.P.V. Engineer Pvt. Ltd., capitalizing on our assets - a world class manufacturing plant,
well-knit network of offices, credible local representatives/agents/dealers based across major
locations of the world, have emerged as a champion in our domain since establishment in 1989. We are
an industry-leading manufacturer and  exporter having proven expertise in offering different types
of Centrifugal Chemical Process Pumps, Chemical Pumps, Chemical Horizontal Self Priming Process
Pumps,  High Pressure Centrifugal Pumps etc. We also deal in Chemical Vertical Sump Pumps, Chemical
Horizontal Process Pumps, and more.

Our rich industry experience spanning over three decades lends us deep functional expertise and
excellent market know-how. This perfectly acquaints us with various application & customers' needs
based on which we design our products. We have resources in place to provide custom-designed pumping
solutions to clients aligning with any type of pumping requirements. Today, our range finds suitable
application in Chemical, Pharmaceutical, Starch, Edible Oil, Textile, Fertilizer, Paper and Effluent
Treatment Industries.

Our entire range is engineered using high grade cast iron, cast steel, and stainless steel, which
gives it durable finish, unmatched functionality, excellent strength, and so forth. All our products
conform to international standards and norms, and enjoy wide demand in India and major international
markets.

**Product Range**

Our product range encompasses the following: (MOC: CI, CS, SS-304/316, CD4MCU, ALLOY-20, HASTALLOY-
B & C, etc.)

* Series 5000 ANSI Chemical Centrifugal Pumps (Back pull-out type)
* Centrifugal Chemical Pumps (Non Back pullout type)
* High Temperature & High Pressure Pumps
* Expeller Design Pumps
* Vertical Sump Pumps
* Self Priming Pumps
* High Pressure Centrifugal Pumps

Through manufacturing, we have continued to think about the future of people, society, and the

#### Sustainability

Humanity is now facing major social issues such as global warming and resource depletion. Under the
slogan of "Supporting the world with technology," the EBARA Group is working to solve a wide range
of social issues and contribute to the sustainable development of the earth and society through the
technological capabilities and passion it has cultivated over the years, as well as various
solutions.

[View Sustainability][198]

#### Innovation Story

Ebara was founded in 1912 as a venture company originating from a university. Since that time, in
order to meet the needs of society and customers, we have boldly taken on challenges in the spirit
of "passion and sincerity" even in unknown areas. This spirit of innovation has been inherited to
the present day, and we continue to provide new value to the world by sincerely responding to the
diversifying needs of our customers, contributing to the resolution of social issues.

[See the innovation story][199]
[ [YouTube video:Generating a New Wave, Designing a New World] ][200]

## Generating a New Wave, Designing a New World

Generating a New Wave, Designing a New World

The EBARA Group has supported the ever-changing industry and social infrastructure, as well as the
evolving information society, with technologies that create the "flow" of water, air, electronics,
and energy. From now on, we will continue to create new "flows" that are needed in a changing world,
and create a better future full of rich smiles.

## Success stories

[Scaffolding surrounds a house under construction, with wooden beams and green textured hempcrete
panels]
[How a Slovenian SME is pushing green construction into the digital era][39]

A Slovenian green-building company, Cogreen Integrated Hemp Building Solutions, is upgrading its
hempcrete innovation with advanced digital tools. With support from a leading Slovenian university,
CoGreen is adopting BIM, AI analytics, and XR technologies to scale prefabricated, modular, and
sustainable construction.
* 23 Jul 2026

[Aerial view of Earth’s oceans with a colour-coded scale for the location of fish]
[Finding fish is no longer a guessing game with AI-driven location forecasting][40]

Using historical data, satellite images and supercomputing, the Iceland-based company GreenFish
provides 10-day forecasts to fishing industry captains and fleet managers. Faced with financial and
technological hurdles due to its rapid growth, the company sought help from the Enterprise Europe
Network.
* 16 Jul 2026

[A Nira water pump with a blue top and silver metal handle ]
[Finnish hand pumps become more sustainable][41]

When Finnish company Nira Pumps needed to cut energy costs, it turned to Europe for help. By
investing in sustainability, this pump manufacturer transformed its business with the future in
mind.

technological hurdles due to its rapid growth, the company sought help from the Enterprise Europe
Network.

mind.

We deeply understand how people live, and the rituals and experiences that enrich life. This is
where hidden insights are uncovered, and how exceptional appliance design helps make life easier.

## Perfect Results

Discover perfect results with appliances that are designed to deliver exceptional performance and
precision.

environment.

## Built to Last

Designed and engineered using quality materials and finishes intended to stand the test of time.

## Respect for
## The Planet

Live more sustainably, with appliances designed to reduce energy and water use, without compromising
performance.

## Ultimate Kitchen Solutions

Transform ingredients into cuisine, chores into beautiful experiences, and routines into rituals
with combinations of luxury kitchen appliances designed to work seamlessly together.

Love your laundry with appliances that are designed to reflect how you live and that care for the
garments you treasure.

designed to pair perfectly both in form and function, to get the best results from delicates to
durables and everything in between.

details about our carbon emissions goals, strategy and roadmap.

# Welcome to Framo

Safe, efficient and reliable pumping systems.

For over half a century, our world-leading pump technology has revolutionized marine cargo pumping.
Framo has supplied cargo pumping systems to the majority of chemical and product tankers worldwide,
and are recognized as a standard in the marine industry. We are also driving greater short-term and
long-term profitability in hundreds of oil and gas installations worldwide.
 
Our strong customer focus, unique pumping concepts, high-quality engineering and dedicated service
ensures overall performance in challenging pumping operations.

# The Framo Advantage

We see our products through from design to full scale testing at our own production facilities
outside Bergen, Norway. Full worldwide support throughout the service life of the products - no
matter the problem.

Our strong customer focus has resulted in pumping systems developed in close collaboration with our
customers, with the aim to enhance safe, efficient and reliable pumping operations.

göre sevkiyat analizleri sunar. Rakip firmaların hangi alıcılara, ne miktarda, hangi tarihlerde

## Sıkça Sorulan Sorular - Dış Ticaret & Gümrük İstihbaratı

Küresel ticaret veri analitiği, gümrük sorgulamaları ve konşimento hakkında merak edilen tüm
sorulara doğrudan yanıtlar.

### S: TurkExim ithalat-ihracat veritabanı nedir ve ne işe yarar?

**TurkExim**, 39'dan fazla ülkenin resmi gümrük kayıtlarını ve deniz taşımacılığı yük
manifestolarını (konşimento/manifest) derleyen gelişmiş bir ticari istihbarat arama motorudur. Hangi
ithalatçının, hangi tür ürünleri, hangi sıklıkla, hangi hacimlerde ve hangi tedarikçilerden satın
aldığını anında tespit etmenizi sağlar. Böylece pazar pazar gezmeden hedef alıcılarınızı masa
başında belirleyebilirsiniz.

### S: Konşimento (Bill of Lading) verilerini analiz etmek ihracatçılara ne fayda sağlar?

Konşimento analizleri, B2B ticaret dünyasında küresel bir alıcının aktifliğini ve gerçek işlem
hacimlerini doğrulamanın en güvenilir yoludur. Klasik firma dizinlerinin aksine konşimentolar,
fiziksel bir sevkiyatın gerçekleştiğini gümrük nezdinde resmi olarak belgeler. Bu sayede aktif
olmayan veya aracı olan paravan şirketleri filtreleyip doğrudan **gerçek alıcılara** ulaşma şansı
elde edersiniz.

### S: TurkExim verileri ile pazar araştırması ve rakip analizi nasıl yapılır?

Sistem üzerinden hedef ürününüzün **GTİP (HS Code)** numarasını sorguladığınızda şu analizlere
erişebilirsiniz:
* İlgili ürünü dünyada en çok satın alan ithalatçıların unvanları ve satın alma hacimleri.
* Rakiplerinizin yurt dışındaki müşterileri, hangi limanları kullandıkları ve yükleme sıklıkları.
* Süreklilik arz eden, finansal riski düşük ve gümrük işlemi düzenli olan sürdürülebilir ihracat
  kanalları.

## Küresel Ticari İstihbarat ve Analiz Hizmetleri

TurkExim'in dış ticarette neden en güvenilir iş ortağınız olduğunu keşfedin.

### Biz Kimiz?

TurkExim, dünya çapındaki 39'dan fazla ülkede ithalatçı ve ihracatçı firmaların doğrudan ve şeffaf
bağlar kurmasına olanak tanıyan küresel bir ticari istihbarat platformudur. Milyonlarca ham gümrük
beyannamesini işlenebilir ticari verilere dönüştürerek satış ekiplerinizin nokta atışı ihracat
hedeflerine ulaşmasını sağlıyoruz.

[ Çözümlerimizi Keşfedin → ][27]

### Konşimento Veritabanı (Bill of Lading)

TurkExim Konşimento Veritabanı, gümrüklerde kullanılan Armonize Sistem (GTİP / HS Code) kodlarına
göre sevkiyat analizleri sunar. Rakip firmaların hangi alıcılara, ne miktarda, hangi tarihlerde
yükleme yaptığını tam şeffaflıkla inceleyebilir ve tedarik zincirindeki hareketleri gerçek zamanlı
görebilirsiniz.

[ Konşimento Verilerini İnceleyin → ][28]

## Canlı Veri Arama Deneyimi

#### Bulunan Potansiyel Alıcı Analizleri

## Sıkça Sorulan Sorular - Dış Ticaret & Gümrük İstihbaratı

Küresel ticaret veri analitiği, gümrük sorgulamaları ve konşimento hakkında merak edilen tüm
sorulara doğrudan yanıtlar.

### S: TurkExim ithalat-ihracat veritabanı nedir ve ne işe yarar?

**TurkExim**, 39'dan fazla ülkenin resmi gümrük kayıtlarını ve deniz taşımacılığı yük
manifestolarını (konşimento/manifest) derleyen gelişmiş bir ticari istihbarat arama motorudur. Hangi
ithalatçının, hangi tür ürünleri, hangi sıklıkla, hangi hacimlerde ve hangi tedarikçilerden satın
aldığını anında tespit etmenizi sağlar. Böylece pazar pazar gezmeden hedef alıcılarınızı masa
başında belirleyebilirsiniz.

### S: Konşimento (Bill of Lading) verilerini analiz etmek ihracatçılara ne fayda sağlar?

Konşimento analizleri, B2B ticaret dünyasında küresel bir alıcının aktifliğini ve gerçek işlem
hacimlerini doğrulamanın en güvenilir yoludur. Klasik firma dizinlerinin aksine konşimentolar,
fiziksel bir sevkiyatın gerçekleştiğini gümrük nezdinde resmi olarak belgeler. Bu sayede aktif
olmayan veya aracı olan paravan şirketleri filtreleyip doğrudan **gerçek alıcılara** ulaşma şansı
elde edersiniz.

### S: TurkExim verileri ile pazar araştırması ve rakip analizi nasıl yapılır?

Sistem üzerinden hedef ürününüzün **GTİP (HS Code)** numarasını sorguladığınızda şu analizlere
erişebilirsiniz:
* İlgili ürünü dünyada en çok satın alan ithalatçıların unvanları ve satın alma hacimleri.
* Rakiplerinizin yurt dışındaki müşterileri, hangi limanları kullandıkları ve yükleme sıklıkları.
* Süreklilik arz eden, finansal riski düşük ve gümrük işlemi düzenli olan sürdürülebilir ihracat
  kanalları.

Industrial pumps are mechanical devices that move fluid, water, and heavy-duty materials such as
chemicals, food, slurry, or sewage from one place to another. The manufacturing industry broadly
uses industrial pumps to circulate fluids and remove contaminants from fluids.
2How does an industrial pumps work?
An industrial pump converts mechanical energy into hydraulic energy. The impeller accelerates the
liquid and creates pressure that forces the fluid to move outwards.
3How to maintain industrial pumps?
Regular maintenance of the industrial pump is necessary to ensure it operates seamlessly and
smoothly. For regular maintenance, you can check and secure mounting bolts, fluid leaks, packing,
oil level, oil leaks, and grease. This will result in the extended life of the pump.
4What is the function of the industrial pumps?
The core function of an industrial pump is to accelerate materials when they need to move at high
flow rates. Industrial pumps can pump water from wells, filter aquariums or ponds, lift liquid from
lower to upper level, and also act as a booster in a piping network system.
5How can I determine the right industrial pump for my specific manufacturing needs?
To decide on the right industrial pumps, you need to consider factors such as the type of fluid you
need to remove, pressure requirements, flow rate, operational environment, and the pump materials
you require for your manufacturing needs.

About Us

## About  Us

##### Our Business Approach

 

##### Product Design Philosophy

 

##### Infrastructure & Facilities

##### Social Development

An institution owes its existence to the people and the society at large. We strongly believe that
social development through various outreach and awareness programs is as important as development of
the company. Instead of a responsibility, we perceive social development as the primary purpose of
the existence of the company. Through various art forms like music and theatre we support awareness
programs  related to water usage and recycling.

We have built state of the art infrastructure which is also being evolved continuously to leverage
technological improvements in the design and manufacturing processes. Our complete in-house control
on the design and manufacture of the components ensures highest level of quality required after
thoroughly understanding the application requirements. The manufacturing facilities are spread out
across 4 locations which each plant specialising in a particular process. 

We design & manufacture tailor-made products for pumping and mixing of corrosive, abrasive and
solids laden liquids, alongwith suitable service support for critical applications including sewage,
seawater, industrial wastewater, chemical processes, & corrosive liquids. We have one of widest
spectrums of material options to suit the application based on over 5 decades of experience and
expertise. At the core of product selection process, lies a deep understanding of the application
and the environment in which the pump is supposed to operate,  ensuring optimal selection to suit
the requirement.

The design procedure for the products revolves around a holistic approach which incorporates factors
that optimise the resource efficiency over the lifecycle of the product. Every product designed from
concept to its final form, minimises the impact on natural resources. We have to realise that the
environment has limited capacity to supply us with the valuable natural resources which the Earth is
endowed with. The design philosophy revolves around maximising of reuse and recycling of the
materials used in manufacturing.

## About  Us

##### Our Business Approach

 

##### Product Design Philosophy

 

##### Infrastructure & Facilities

##### Social Development

An institution owes its existence to the people and the society at large. We strongly believe that
social development through various outreach and awareness programs is as important as development of
the company. Instead of a responsibility, we perceive social development as the primary purpose of
the existence of the company. Through various art forms like music and theatre we support awareness
programs  related to water usage and recycling.

We have built state of the art infrastructure which is also being evolved continuously to leverage
technological improvements in the design and manufacturing processes. Our complete in-house control
on the design and manufacture of the components ensures highest level of quality required after
thoroughly understanding the application requirements. The manufacturing facilities are spread out
across 4 locations which each plant specialising in a particular process. 

We design & manufacture tailor-made products for pumping and mixing of corrosive, abrasive and
solids laden liquids, alongwith suitable service support for critical applications including sewage,
seawater, industrial wastewater, chemical processes, & corrosive liquids. We have one of widest
spectrums of material options to suit the application based on over 5 decades of experience and
expertise. At the core of product selection process, lies a deep understanding of the application
and the environment in which the pump is supposed to operate,  ensuring optimal selection to suit
the requirement.

The design procedure for the products revolves around a holistic approach which incorporates factors
that optimise the resource efficiency over the lifecycle of the product. Every product designed from
concept to its final form, minimises the impact on natural resources. We have to realise that the
environment has limited capacity to supply us with the valuable natural resources which the Earth is
endowed with. The design philosophy revolves around maximising of reuse and recycling of the
materials used in manufacturing.

# ONE-STOP SHOP RAS EQUIPMENT MANUFACTURER

Recirculating aquaculture systems from equipment design and manufacturing to equipment supply and
installation support at your fish farm development or any land based aquaculture application.

[Recirculating aquaculture systems - ras]

## BEST SELLING AQUACULTURE FILTRATION EQUIPMENT

[[Compact recirculating aquaculture system cras 100]][48] [

### RAS Skid Filtration Units

][49]

Fully integrated plug & play and factory tested RAS filtration technology. It covers mechanical,
biological, chemical and disinfection filtration processes and state of the art monitoring with low
energy consumption and ease of operation. RAS Skids are tailor made solutions to fit your needs,
site conditions and available space.

[[Freshwater protein skimmer aquaculture]][50] [

### Freshwater Protein Skimmers

][51]

Seafood farmers, especially Salmon Farmers, requested MAT-KULING to develop an efficient Freshwater
Protein Skimmer able to perform in fresh and brackish water conditions and installed for land based
salmon tanks. The protein skimmer is an add-on to the existing filtration setup.

[[Foam fractionator aquaculture]][52] [

### Saltwater Protein Skimmers

][53]

The Protein Skimmers made of PE & PP bodies come ready with Venturi pumps, automated protein foam
level control, skimmer cap sludge autowash, control panel & ozone/oxygen intake. Assembled and
hydrotested ready for installation.

[[Drum filters for aquaculture]][54] [

### Drum Filters

][55]

Drum Filters suitable for aquaculture fish farms, salmon farms, saltwater applications or
hippopotamus zoos and elephant zoological water.

[[Ozone generators suitable for aquaculture farms & fish hatcheries]][56] [

### Ozone Generators

][57]

Ozone Generators designed and tested for RAS applications. Fabricated in respect with EU & US HSE
guidelines in our factory with quality components easy to repair or replace. Equipped with control
panel and optionally with oxygen concentrators, air chillers and air dryers.

[[Mbbr aquaculture moving bed biofilm reactor filter]][58] [

### Moving Bed Biofilter Reactors (MBBR)

][59]

The MBBR filters are made of PP plastic and they are designed to create proper media swell, allowing
maximum bacteria oxygenation with minimal backwash requirements. Filled with floating biomedia will
provide optimum biological filtration support.

[ View all Equipment][60]

NIVA (Norwegian Institute for Water Research) officials, performed an independent, field trial on
MAT-KULING freshwater protein skimmer performance in a salmon farm in Norway and reported more than
70% particles removal.

[ DETAILED NIVA RESULTS][61]

[[Step inside mat-kuling vannbehandling as]
Watch this video on YouTube][63]

MAT-KULING is a Norwegian manufacturer of high quality water treatment equipment co-owned by MAT
FILTRATION TECHNOLOGIES and KULING VANNBEHANDLING and is specialized in Recirculating Aquaculture
Systems (RAS) for Land Based Aquaculture. **MAT-KULING is not focusing on building fish farms or
providing turn key fish operator solutions.** Our technology covers from equipment design and
manufacturing, and supply to training and installation support at your fish farm development or any
land based aquaculture application. Our RAS equipment range covers the latest technology in
mechanical and biological filtration as well as disinfection systems such as ozone and UV solutions.
On the contrary, it aims to be subcontracted for the complete filtration scope supply and
installation support for all MEP and RAS equipment of a fish farm or hatchery. We sell equipment and
we guarantee our filtration technology will meet and exceed the policy requirements set by fish farm
operators.

Seafood farmers, especially Salmon Farmers, requested MAT-KULING to develop an efficient Freshwater
Protein Skimmer able to perform in fresh and brackish water conditions and installed for land based
salmon tanks. The protein skimmer is an add-on to the existing filtration setup.

[[Foam fractionator aquaculture]][52] [

### Saltwater Protein Skimmers

][53]

The Protein Skimmers made of PE & PP bodies come ready with Venturi pumps, automated protein foam
level control, skimmer cap sludge autowash, control panel & ozone/oxygen intake. Assembled and
hydrotested ready for installation.

[[Drum filters for aquaculture]][54] [

### Drum Filters

][55]

Drum Filters suitable for aquaculture fish farms, salmon farms, saltwater applications or
hippopotamus zoos and elephant zoological water.

[[Ozone generators suitable for aquaculture farms & fish hatcheries]][56] [

### Ozone Generators

][57]

Ozone Generators designed and tested for RAS applications. Fabricated in respect with EU & US HSE
guidelines in our factory with quality components easy to repair or replace. Equipped with control
panel and optionally with oxygen concentrators, air chillers and air dryers.

[[Mbbr aquaculture moving bed biofilm reactor filter]][58] [

### Moving Bed Biofilter Reactors (MBBR)

][59]

The MBBR filters are made of PP plastic and they are designed to create proper media swell, allowing
maximum bacteria oxygenation with minimal backwash requirements. Filled with floating biomedia will
provide optimum biological filtration support.

[ View all Equipment][60]

## NIVA RESULTS: UP TO 70% PARTICLES REMOVAL IN FRESHWATER PROTEIN SKIMMERS

NIVA (Norwegian Institute for Water Research) officials, performed an independent, field trial on
MAT-KULING freshwater protein skimmer performance in a salmon farm in Norway and reported more than
70% particles removal.

[ DETAILED NIVA RESULTS][61]
[[Particles removal during time diagram in freshwater protein skimmers]][62]Particles Removal During
Time in Freshwater Protein Skimmers

## Filtration Systems for Intensive Aquaculture Farms

We fabricate low energy consumption Water Treatment equipment for biological filtration, mechanical
filtration, and disinfection solutions in the aquaculture industry.

[Recirculating aquaculture systems]

## MAT-KULING MANUFACTURER, SUPPLIER

Step Inside MAT-KULING VANNBEHANDLING AS
[[Step inside mat-kuling vannbehandling as]
Watch this video on YouTube][63]

MAT-KULING is a Norwegian manufacturer of high quality water treatment equipment co-owned by MAT
FILTRATION TECHNOLOGIES and KULING VANNBEHANDLING and is specialized in Recirculating Aquaculture
Systems (RAS) for Land Based Aquaculture. **MAT-KULING is not focusing on building fish farms or
providing turn key fish operator solutions.** Our technology covers from equipment design and
manufacturing, and supply to training and installation support at your fish farm development or any
land based aquaculture application. Our RAS equipment range covers the latest technology in
mechanical and biological filtration as well as disinfection systems such as ozone and UV solutions.
On the contrary, it aims to be subcontracted for the complete filtration scope supply and
installation support for all MEP and RAS equipment of a fish farm or hatchery. We sell equipment and
we guarantee our filtration technology will meet and exceed the policy requirements set by fish farm
operators.

Oswal Pumps Limited, commenced its operations in 2003, is now recognized as one of the fastest
growing company, vertically integrated solar pump manufacturers in india. Its success can be
attributed to a highly experienced team of engineers and technicians, who have contributed to the
Company's growth in the field of solar pumps, submersible pumps, monoblock pumps, pressure pumps,

company's manufacturing facility spans across an area of 41076 sq. meters which is strategically
located in or near major agricultural states such as Haryana, Punjab and Uttar Pradesh and is
equipped with modern machineries. Oswal Pumps Limited is an ISO 9001:2015 certified company and its

About us

### 
### ShenGu Group , a Global Actor 
### in Process and Energy Equipment

###### About ShenGu Group

         Established in 1952, the ShenGu Group Co., Ltd (ShenGu Group) dedicates itself to the
research, development, design, and manufacturing of turbomachinery including
centrifugal/axial/reciprocating compressors, centrifugal blowers and pumps. The main areas of its
application are oil & gas, chemical, metallurgy, power generation, etc.


        Through continuous investments in facilities and product development, ShenGu Group has
achieved a dominant position in both Chinese and overseas market.  

        Nowadays, ShenGu Group has 80% of China’s local market share and has installations in over
40 countries.

 

Basic data:


Area total: 1.6 million m2

Employee:   More than 6,500.

Production equipment:

More than 2000 Machining equipment.

Testing capacity:

More than  30 test beds with capacity up to 100,000KW

 

[MAC180 Rotor assembly in shop.jpg]

## ShenGu Group, a top manufacturer delivers 300+ large gas compressors per year.

ShenGu Group has developed a wide range of new products, including  25MW high speed natural gas
pipeline booster compressor,  1.5 million tons/year ethylene plants centrifugal compressors,  2.5
million tons/year methanol plants compressors and key compression equipment for refineries up to 40
million tons/year capacity, as well as air separation plants capacity up to 150,000 Nm3/h of oxygen.
 

## QUALITY CERTIFICATES

ISO 9001: 2008

ISO 14000: 2004

ISO 12012: 2003

  This series is designed for maximum 140℃ water and industrial fluids.The material of pump casing
  is cast iron HT250 and ductile iron QT400. The pumps are equipped with air-cooled asynchronous

  TWZ pumps are non-self-priming, single-stage, cantilever monoblock centrifugal volute pumps with

  and PN25 body pressure versions. The pumps are fitted with air-cooled asynchronous motors.
  Impeller and motor shaft are connected via a rigid sleeve coupling (stub shaft). The pumps are
  fitted with a mechanical shaft seal. The pumps provide a compact arrangement ideal for
  installations where space is at a premium. With its compact and space-saving design, this pump is
  ideal for use in industrial, commercial, and residential settings where space is limited.In fact,
  TWZ series horizontal rigid coupled cantilever single-stage single-suction centrifugal pump is
  derived from TPW series. It shares the same pump body,impeller as TPW and the same motor support

  media. The pumps are of the back-pull-out design, that is you can remove the motor, motor stool

  different pipeline system caliber and pressure level configuration.

  bottom. The medium to be pumped is sucked in axially from the bottom, then discharged laterally
  from the pump body.
  
  The impeller is fixed on the motor shaft extension, forming a common rotor component with the

  bottom. The medium to be pumped is sucked in axially from the bottom, then discharged laterally
  from the pump body.
  
  The impeller is fixed on the motor shaft extension, forming a common rotor component with the
  motor shaft. The pump body and pump cover together form the pressure boundary, designed for a
  temperature of 40°C. The design pressure for pumps with a head of less than 40m is 0.6MPa, and for

  close-coupled structure suitable for fixed firefighting applications. The pump impeller is
  directly mounted on the extended shaft of the motor. Both the pump inlet and outlet are flanged
  connections, with axial inlet port, radial outlet port and horizontal shaft on the base. The pump
  does not have bearings; both axial and radial forces are supported by the motor's bearings. The

# A top industrial company that truly creates value for stakeholders

#### We serve essential industries to contribute to a prosperous economy and sustainable society

### Sulzer Annual Results 2025

Executive Chair, Suzanne Thoma stated: "Our initiatives for excellence paid off: we are more
efficient, as our ROCE and our profitability are clearly showing. This is the result of a team
working together globally. I would like to thank our Sulzer team all over the world for their
efforts and their openness to change"

### Squaring the circle

At Sulzer, we know resources are finite, and we must learn to use them more efficiently. But how do
we achieve this while sustaining economic growth? In other words, how do we square the circle of
efficiency in using resources while finding business opportunities? We believe one solution to this
challenge is circularity, implemented through our services allowing our clients to extend product
and infrastructure lifecycles.

## Introducing TRVST

Hello. Thank you for stopping by. At TRVST we’re working to champion change makers, their stories
and inspire collective action for positive change. We believe that by helping to join the dots
between people with the passion to make a difference and the resources required to achieve the
outcomes that matter we can all help to address many of the big issues of our time.

From [climate change][64], [plastic pollution][65], [zero waste][66] through [sustainable
fashion][67] & [equality][68]. And looking after ourselves and each other. There’s a lot our
individual contributions summed can achieve. 

Behind the scenes, we’ve big plans to build technology to help make all this happen. Meanwhile,
we’re busy sharing content to inspire the future we want to see. Enjoy, have a click around and hit
the sign up button below for occasional updates.

# **WORKING TO ADVANCE FISH WELFARE**

As pioneers in aquaculture with more than 30 years of experience, VAKI^{®} provides best-in-class
fish **[counters][43]**, fish **[graders][44]**, and fish **[pumps][45]** for the global aquaculture
industry.

Our innovative production equipment and smart technology enable farms to operate efficiently. This
makes fish handling, counting and measurement as easy as possible.

Explore our **VAKI SOLUTIONS**:

[LAND][46]

[BIOMASS & SEA LICE][47]

[WELLBOATS][48]

**[COUNTERS][49]**

**COUNTING, HIGH CAPACITY & IMAGE VERIFICATION **

From our basic counters to our infrared and Smart models, VAKI has an extensive range of counters
using the best available technology solutions for the demands of our customers.

[Learn more][50]

**[GRADERS][51]**

**HIGH-PRECISION GRADING **

VAKI offers a versatile range of Fish Graders (both Smart Roller Graders and Drum Graders) to
deliver grading while minimizing the impact on the fish.

[Learn more][52]

**[PUMPS][53]**

**HIGH CAPACITY, EFFICIENT & EASY TO MOVE**

Available in three sizes and either the Basic or Smart Pump model, VAKI fish pumps offer a gentle
and fast way to transfer fish – reducing operating costs and improving efficiency.

[Learn more][54]

**[SMARTFLOW][55]**

**SETTING NEW STANDARDS FOR THE INDUSTRY **

VAKI SmartFlow is an automated and customised solution that delivers* *real-time monitoring
technology to advance fish health with welfare-friendly fish handling, counting and grading.

[Learn more][56]

**VAKI SMARTFLOW** — THE ULTIMATE FISH HANDLING SOLUTION

Built with farmers in mind, and with fish welfare at its core, our industry leading **VAKI
SmartFlow** System connects all VAKI Smart Pumps^{*}, Graders and Counters for full overview and
control of the fish handling system.

This revolutionizes production efficiency by leveraging real-time monitoring, remote control,
automation, and reporting to deliver key insights for decision making and informed planning.

**Explore our solutions for hatcheries, wellboats and sea pens — [click to download our interactive
PDF to learn more.][57]**

** Non-Smart Pumps may be used in the SmartFlow system, but pumping automation, remote-control and
monitoring capabilities will be lost.*

## **REVOLUTIONIZING OPERATIONS**

With **VAKI SmartFlow**, we gather valuable production data to provide a comprehensive overview of
your operations, amplifying the excellent performance of our **Smart** **Pumps, Smart Graders, and
Smart Counters**, and helping you to more accurately:

## **ELEVATE PERFORMANCE & ENHANCE PROFITIBILITY**

Download our VAKI^{®} SmartFlow brochure and **learn more about how VAKI can help you improve your
aquaculture operations**.

[Download to learn more >][58]

**LET’S ADVANCE AQUATIC WELFARE & SUSTAINABILITY, TOGETHER**.

**Contact your MSD Animal Health representative today **to learn more about

optimising your production efficiency with VAKI’s powerful aquaculture technology.

[Contact Us >][59]

# Your global full scope **maritime**** safety partner**

What if you only had to rely on one proven partner for all your maritime safety needs?

**VIKING Life-Saving Equipment** brings you all the solutions you need to stay safe and
compliant. Our range includes everything from lifeboats, fast rescue boats and evacuation systems to
liferafts, personal protective gear, firefighting equipment and safety training.

Powered by the industry’s strongest network, we provide worldwide multi-brand equipment service with
OEM quality and support the thousands of maritime and offshore operators who prefer subscribing to
safety compliance with a fixed price safety agreement.

[

### Fire Suppression (NEW)

[Fire Suppression (NEW)]

Portable fire protection made simple. The Wastecorp Fire Suppression Cube FP-275 delivers
high-capacity firefighting performance in a compact, self-contained package.

][141] [

### Double Disc Pump

[Double Disc Pump]

Wastecorp has elevated double disc pump technology to the next level. Meet the Sludge Pro® double
disc pump MK Series based on the induced flow principle with rotating frame.

][142] [

### Diaphragm Pumps

[Diaphragm Pumps]

Wastecorp designs and manufactures Mud Sucker Diaphragm Pumps for the global marketplace. Mud Sucker
diaphragm pumps are available in single and double diaphragm configurations with up to 280 GPM
capabilities.

][143] [

### Plunger Pumps

[Plunger Pumps]

Official plunger pump manufacturers page. Sludge Master Plunger Pumps are the ultimate heavy solids
handling pumps for municipal and industrial fluid handling applications. Designed and manufactured
by Wastecorp in North America.

][144] [

### Honey Wagon

[Honey Wagon]

Honey wagon waste containment and sanitation systems are available in several sizes ranging from 25
gallon (96 liters) to over 5000 gallon (18,900 liters) tank sizes and beyond.

][145] [

### Water Trailers

[Water Trailers]

Water trailers are designed for on-site water delivery, dust control on construction sites, heavy
equipment washing.

][146] [

### Trash Pumps Self-Priming

[Trash Pumps Self-Priming ]

Trash Flow® self priming trash pumps are designed for municipal, industrial and commercial
wastewater treatment applications. Choose from chopper style pumps to wet prime, dry prime, silent
models and lift stations. Multiple sizes, and discharge head models available.

][147] [

### Pump Parts

[Pump Parts]

Wastecorp supplies current and select obsolete parts for Pumps. Pumps include: diaphragm pumps,
plunger pumps, self priming centrifugal pumps and double disc pumps

][148]



## Video & News

### Maine WWTP Specs Trash Flow Dry Prime Pump

Wastecorp worked with Wright Pierce Environmental Engineers and local contractor Penta Contractors
to design and deliver a new dry prime pump for a bypass operation.

### City Of Detroit Uses Trash Flow Dry Prime Pumps

The Trash Flow TFV Series helps the City and a local Water Authority manage storm water and heavy
rainfall.

### MK Series Double Disc Pump

Check out the Sludge Pro Double Disc Pump MK Series. Induced Flow style double disc pumps.

### Super Duty Vacuum Pumps - Overview

An overview of vacuum pumps available for industrial, commercial, construction and marine use.

## Explore Our Range

[

### Fire Suppression (NEW)

[Fire Suppression (NEW)]

Portable fire protection made simple. The Wastecorp Fire Suppression Cube FP-275 delivers
high-capacity firefighting performance in a compact, self-contained package.

][141] [

### Double Disc Pump

[Double Disc Pump]

Wastecorp has elevated double disc pump technology to the next level. Meet the Sludge Pro® double
disc pump MK Series based on the induced flow principle with rotating frame.

][142] [

### Diaphragm Pumps

[Diaphragm Pumps]

Wastecorp designs and manufactures Mud Sucker Diaphragm Pumps for the global marketplace. Mud Sucker
diaphragm pumps are available in single and double diaphragm configurations with up to 280 GPM
capabilities.

][143] [

### Plunger Pumps

[Plunger Pumps]

Official plunger pump manufacturers page. Sludge Master Plunger Pumps are the ultimate heavy solids
handling pumps for municipal and industrial fluid handling applications. Designed and manufactured
by Wastecorp in North America.

][144] [

### Honey Wagon

[Honey Wagon]

Honey wagon waste containment and sanitation systems are available in several sizes ranging from 25
gallon (96 liters) to over 5000 gallon (18,900 liters) tank sizes and beyond.

][145] [

### Water Trailers

[Water Trailers]

Water trailers are designed for on-site water delivery, dust control on construction sites, heavy
equipment washing.

][146] [

### Trash Pumps Self-Priming

[Trash Pumps Self-Priming ]

Trash Flow® self priming trash pumps are designed for municipal, industrial and commercial
wastewater treatment applications. Choose from chopper style pumps to wet prime, dry prime, silent
models and lift stations. Multiple sizes, and discharge head models available.

][147] [

### Pump Parts

[Pump Parts]

Wastecorp supplies current and select obsolete parts for Pumps. Pumps include: diaphragm pumps,
plunger pumps, self priming centrifugal pumps and double disc pumps

][148]



## Video & News

### Maine WWTP Specs Trash Flow Dry Prime Pump

Wastecorp worked with Wright Pierce Environmental Engineers and local contractor Penta Contractors
to design and deliver a new dry prime pump for a bypass operation.

### City Of Detroit Uses Trash Flow Dry Prime Pumps

The Trash Flow TFV Series helps the City and a local Water Authority manage storm water and heavy
rainfall.

### MK Series Double Disc Pump

Check out the Sludge Pro Double Disc Pump MK Series. Induced Flow style double disc pumps.

### Super Duty Vacuum Pumps - Overview

An overview of vacuum pumps available for industrial, commercial, construction and marine use.

* [why (1)][why2 (1)]
  
  ## Manufacturer Direct
  
  An integrated aquarium manufacturer specialising in R&D, production and sales, offering a
  comprehensive range of products and supplying high-quality goods directly from the factory to
  customers worldwide.
* [why (2)][why2 (2)]
  
  ## OEM/ODM Customisation
  
  With our own dedicated R&D team, we support end-to-end OEM/ODM customisation, allowing for the
  design and adjustment of appearance, specifications and functionality to meet specific
  requirements.
* [why (3)][why2 (3)]
  
  ## Secure & Rapid Delivery
  
  Standard models are kept in stock for immediate dispatch, enabling a swift response to urgent
  orders; custom orders are scheduled specifically to meet clients’ delivery timelines.
* [why (4)][why2 (4)]
  
  ## Large-Scale Production Capacity
  
  Multiple automated production lines ensure ample capacity to handle large-volume wholesale and
  custom orders, with stable supply even during peak seasons.
* [why (8)][why2 (5)]
  
  ## Strict Quality Control
  
  A closed-loop quality control system across the entire production process, with products
  undergoing multiple rounds of specialised safety inspections to minimise after-sales issues and
  customer complaints from the outset.
* [why (5)][why2 (6)]
  
  ## After-Sales Service Guarantee
  
  Genuine products come with a comprehensive warranty system, supported by dedicated after-sales
  staff providing one-to-one support throughout the process, offering a one-stop solution for all
  issues.
* [why (6)][why2 (7)]
  
  ## Technical Expertise
  
  Our experienced technical team provides customised, one-stop aquarium solutions, empowering
  partners throughout the entire process to resolve technical challenges.
* [why (7)][why2 (8)]
  
  ## Quality Assurance
  
  Our entire product range has passed multiple authoritative certifications, including China’s 3C
  Compulsory Certification and the EU’s CE Safety Certification. All qualifications are complete and
  verifiable, with these authoritative certifications serving as a solid endorsement of product
  quality.
